batches.section: §A prerequisite + §B (F-004: the rustty-xev FreeBSD kqueue backend)

findings.title: FreeBSD selects the kqueue backend but the kqueue API is macOS-only, so real consumers cannot type-check

batches.note: The design's adversary pass caught a would-be crash here: it initially proposed a panicking notify handle for the FreeBSD thread pool, but the oracle's wakeup is comptime-Darwin-gated (kqueue.zig:965-968), so FreeBSD thread_perform must be PUSH-ONLY. Honor that. Also note the design settled IUTF8 = 0x00004000 against the real FreeBSD 14.3 header, and that kevent's struct field widths differ from macOS - verify each against the actual FreeBSD headers/libc crate rather than assuming. Wave 1 edited kqueue.rs (W13A-01 stale-cached-time fix) - merge, don't clobber. Proof bar: `cargo check -p rustty-xev --target x86_64-unknown-freebsd --all-targets`.
